purpose.domain_detail: UK electoral vote counting — processes constituency voting records and tallies votes per political party
purpose.summary: EXPPROG4 reads a binary vote input file record by record, validates each record against a given constituency ID, then iterates through up to 72 vote values per record tallying counts for named UK political parties (Conservative, Labour, Liberal, SNP, Plaid Cymru, etc.) and spoilt votes. It writes results to an output file and displays status messages throughout.

notable_features: OCCURS 72 TIMES INDEXED BY VOTE-IDX for vote array
88-level condition names used extensively for state flags
Incomplete program — W001-WRITE-WINNER section is empty/stub
SET REC-INVALID TO FALSE appears to be a bug (should be TRUE)
verdict.notes: Program appears to be a student exercise (author Hannah Jacob, dated July 2021, installation RSM likely a university). The W001-WRITE-WINNER section is completely empty and W000-WRITE-LOSER uses ENDIF instead of END-IF (non-standard). There is a likely logic bug: 'SET REC-INVALID TO FALSE' should probably be 'SET REC-INVALID TO TRUE'. The EVALUATE VOTE-VALUE references the group item rather than an indexed element, which may be another bug. No lines exceed 72 characters confirming fixed format.
